assets.reader_question: Where is the optional Windows Unblock control?
assets.alt: Windows MSI Properties dialog with the Unblock checkbox selected and emphasized
assets.caption: On the General tab, select Unblock only when Windows displays this downloaded-file security notice, then choose Apply or OK.
assets.update_trigger: Windows Properties security UI or installation guidance changes

assets.reader_question: What should the initial application look like?
assets.alt: ESO Weave at first launch with ESO inactive and separate Install actions for both managed addons
assets.caption: Deterministic first-launch state: ESO is inactive, ESO Weave is active, and each absent managed addon has its own Install action.
assets.update_trigger: Main layout, first-launch status, or lifecycle controls change

assets.reader_question: What does a healthy observed baseline look like?
assets.alt: ESO Weave showing a healthy running game, managed data addon, and detected PixelBeacon signal
assets.caption: Deterministic healthy baseline: the game and world are active, both managed addons are current, and PixelBeacon Signal is detected while data-addon session facts remain separate.
assets.update_trigger: System and State labels or healthy signal contract changes

assets.reader_question: How is a lost signal distinct from an uninstalled addon?
assets.alt: ESO Weave showing PixelBeacon installed with a lost signal and stale retained HUD values
assets.caption: Deterministic lost-signal state: PixelBeacon remains installed, current input authority is unavailable, and the last coherent HUD is visibly marked stale until recovery or expiry.
assets.update_trigger: Signal-loss label or recovery guidance changes

assets.reader_question: Why are PixelBeacon lifecycle actions unavailable?
assets.alt: ESO Weave showing an unmanaged PixelBeacon target that will not be modified
assets.caption: Deterministic unmanaged state: ownership cannot be proven, so ESO Weave offers no install, update, or removal action for that target.
assets.update_trigger: Ownership classification or available actions change

assets.reader_question: Where are slot type and effective delay configured?
assets.alt: ESO Weave Weaving settings with enabled slots, selected weave types, and effective delays
assets.caption: Deterministic configuration example: each Skills row shows whether it is enabled, its weave type, override state, effective delay, and observed cooldown.
assets.update_trigger: Weaving settings layout or delay presentation changes

assets.reader_question: Where are resource watches, thresholds, and the detected Quickslot binding shown?
assets.alt: ESO Weave Auto Potion settings showing resource watches, thresholds, detected Quickslot binding, and retry interval
assets.caption: Deterministic settings example: Health and Magicka watches are enabled with independent thresholds, Stamina and Ultimate are disabled, and the detected Quickslot binding is read-only.
assets.update_trigger: Resource-watch, threshold, or ready-state UI changes

assets.reader_question: How is a missing PixelBeacon signal reported to Auto Potion?
assets.alt: ESO Weave showing Auto Potion blocked because PixelBeacon signal is unavailable
assets.caption: Deterministic recovery example: the request is retained, but Auto Potion is blocked and sends no input while PixelBeacon Signal is lost.
assets.update_trigger: Block-reason vocabulary or recovery UI changes

assets.reader_question: Where does the PixelBeacon overlay appear?
assets.alt: Synthetic game-window diagram with PixelBeacon color blocks anchored at the top-left
assets.caption: Synthetic example, not live gameplay: PixelBeacon begins at the game client top-left origin, and other interface elements must not cover its cells.
assets.update_trigger: Pixel Bus origin, geometry, or placement rules change
